## Overview

This project implements a multicycle RISC-V processor in SystemVerilog. Each instruction runs over several clock cycles, sequenced by a centralized control FSM. This lets one ALU and one shared instruction/data memory be reused across the steps of every instruction. The design is split into a **controller** (FSM, ALU decoder, and instruction decoder) and a **datapath** (register file, ALU, immediate extender, and non-architectural registers). The two are connected in a top-level `RISCVmulti` module.

The project was developed within a lab framework. I implemented and debugged all of the control sequencing, the datapath connections, and the instruction execution behavior.

Source: [github.com/Swayngee/Multicycle-CPU](https://github.com/Swayngee/Multicycle-CPU)

## Supported Instructions

| Type | Instructions |
|:--|:--|
| R-type | `add`, `sub`, `and`, `or`, `slt` |
| I-type | `addi`, `lw` |
| S-type | `sw` |
| B-type | `beq` |
| J-type | `jal` |

## Control FSM

The main FSM in `fsm.sv` steps through the following states. Transitions out of Decode depend on the opcode.

| State | Name | Action |
|:--|:--|:--|
| S0 | Fetch | Read the instruction from memory, write the IR, PC ← PC + 4 |
| S1 | Decode | Read registers; compute PC + imm for a possible branch target |
| S2 | MemAdr | ALUOut ← rs1 + imm (load/store address) |
| S3 | MemRead | Read data memory at ALUOut |
| S4 | MemWB | Write loaded data to rd |
| S5 | MemWrite | Write rs2 to memory at ALUOut |
| S6 | ExecuteR | ALU operation on rs1, rs2 |
| S7 | ALUWB | Write ALU result to rd |
| S8 | ExecuteI | ALU operation on rs1, imm |
| S9 | JAL | PC ← PC + imm, save the return address |
| S10 | BEQ | Compare rs1 and rs2, branch on the Zero flag |

## Datapath Highlights

- An **OldPC** register holds the address of the current instruction for branch and jump target calculation.
- An **ALUOut** register carries ALU results between cycles.
- A **single shared memory** holds instructions and data, selected by `AdrSrc`.
- The branch decision uses the ALU **Zero** flag.

## Module Breakdown

| File | Purpose |
|:--|:--|
| `RISCVmulti.sv` | Top level connecting the controller and datapath |
| `controller.sv` | Wraps the FSM, ALU decoder, and instruction decoder |
| `fsm.sv` | Multicycle control state machine |
| `ALUDecoder.sv`, `InstrDecoder.sv` | ALU control and immediate-format decoding |
| `datapath.sv` | PC, IR, register file, ALU, and muxes |
| `alu.sv`, `RegFile.sv`, `Extend.sv` | Core datapath blocks |
| `MemUnit.sv` | Shared instruction/data memory |
| `top_dg.sv` | System top connecting the CPU and memory |

## Verification

I simulated the CPU end to end and inspected the waveforms. I verified correct behavior for arithmetic, memory, and control-flow instructions.
